thread:
sam: noticed a pattern where quota and billing show the service-account owner (proj-main) even though requests originated from our proxy pool (proj-proxy-C). means proxy users see quota counts on the wrong project.
rachel: can you paste an example request that reproduces it?
sam: yep: 
```
POST /v1/embeddings
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer impersonation-token
X-Redwood-Proxy-Id: proxy-c1
X-Impersonate-Project: proj-proxy-C
```
deepak: are those tokens minted by the proxy or passed-through?
sam: proxy is doing passthrough for performance - it attaches X-Impersonate-Project for logging. backend auth picks token.sub which is service-account@proj-main so attribution = proj-main.
rachel: we need attribution to reflect business intent (proxy's tenant) not SA owner. options: 1) make proxies exchange tokens (recommended), 2) accept signed proxy header (needs verification), 3) map proxy client cert -> tenant in auth service (mTLS).
deepak: exchange increases latency but is clean. signed header cheaper but requires key rotation and replay protection. cert mapping is attractive for in-cloud proxies.
sam: Console teams: we need dashboards to surface "attributed project" vs "token owner" and show drift percentage per proxy. would help identify broken proxies.
consoleux: we'll add a small panel: two stacked bars (billing attribution / effective origin) and a per-proxy drift rate heatmap. also add ability to filter by model and route.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: auth-exchange@v2 -> canary staging.
rachel: rollout plan proposal: 
- phase 1: implement metric auth.attribution.drift{proxy,route} and dashboard.
- phase 2: require exchange in staging for proxy subset (flag: proxy.require_exchange).
- phase 3: if staging drift drops <0.1% enable in prod for that proxy; else fall back to signed-header pilot.
deepak: for signed-header pilot we should use HMAC with per-proxy secret and include a timestamp and nonce in `X-Proxy-Origin-Sig` to prevent replay. verify in auth service with small cache for nonces.
sam: agree. we should also emit metric auth.origin.verified and auth.origin.replay_detected.
consoleux: add a migration flag in Console UI (per-proxy toggle) and a timeline graph for drift so Product can coordinate customer comms.
rachel: small API change needed: auth response should include origin_source field (values: token_owner, proxy_signed, auth_exchange, client_cert). Console can use that.
deepak: note: origin_source will be added to logs and metrics but not leaked in public API responses.
sam: ok. I'll open PRs: (a) auth-service: origin_source + sig verification, (b) proxies: exchange + optional hmac signing.
ops-bot: canary rolling: auth-service@origin-source -> staging (tag: origin-source-v1).
rachel: timeline: aim for staging canary this week, two day monitoring, then prod half of proxy fleet next week. rollback if drift increases or auth.latency P95 > baseline + 10ms.
deepak: ping me on the PR for nonce cache design.
consoleux: I'll mock the new dashboard panels and share in design channel.
sam: thanks. this should stop accidental quota drains on SA owners and make billing cleaner. :white_check_mark:
